## Subworkflow
Receives one workflow item (already includes repo_* from parent).

Trigger is **Execute Workflow Trigger v1.2** with Input data mode = **Accept all data** (passthrough).
Caller is **Execute Workflow v1.3** (same workflow id, mode=each, continue on error output).

Resolve path → Get file (branch `main`) → large-file HTTP fallback → scrub/compare → create/edit/skip.

Return `github_status` for parent tallies.

parameters.jsCode: const deepStable=v=>{if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map(deepStable);if(v&&typeof v==="object"){const o={};for(const k of Object.keys(v).sort())o[k]=deepStable(v[k]);return o;}return v;};const VOLATILE=new Set(["versionId","updatedAt","createdAt","activeVersionId","meta","pinData","staticData","triggerCount","shared","versionCounter","credentials"]);const scrub=w=>{if(!w||typeof w!=="object")return w;const o={};for(const k of Object.keys(w).sort()){if(VOLATILE.has(k))continue;o[k]=deepStable(w[k]);}return o;};const items=$input.all();const g=items[0];const actual=scrub(items[1].json);let orig=null;if(Object.keys(g.json).includes("content")&&g.json.content)orig=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(g.json.content,"base64").toString());else if(Object.keys(g.json).includes("data")&&g.json.data)orig=JSON.parse(g.json.data);if(orig){const ordered=scrub(orig);if(JSON.stringify(ordered)===JSON.stringify(actual))g.json.github_status="same";else{g.json.github_status="different";g.json.n8n_data_stringy=JSON.stringify(actual,null,2);}g.json.content_decoded=ordered;}else{g.json.github_status="new";g.json.n8n_data_stringy=JSON.stringify(actual,null,2);}return items;

parameters.content:
## Backup to GitHub
Backs up Sorted_Signals-tagged workflows to GitHub daily at 01:33 (instance timezone — set in n8n UI).

**Layout:** `{sanitizedName}__{workflowId}.json` under `gh_repo_path` (flat). Old `YYYY/MM/{id}.json` left for manual cleanup.

**Config:** parent Lookup `global_variables` once → `Attach export config` puts `repo_owner` / `repo_name` / `repo_path` / `repo_branch=main` on each item. Subworkflow does **not** re-lookup.

**GitHub:** branch pinned to `main`. Retries on file ops + large-file HTTP (`retryOnFail`, 3× / 1s between tries). No fixed Wait between successful items.

**Compare:** scrub strips volatile fields so metadata-only changes do not commit.

**Orphans:** alive set = **Filter** output (`isArchived === false`), not raw n8n list — so archived tagged workflows are deleted from GitHub. README / old month paths ignored. Paths deduped before delete.

**Commits:** `[Sorted Signals backup] {name} ({id}) — {new|updated|deleted}`

**Errors:** workflow `errorWorkflow` = `error : telegram notification failed` (`KNq8suchhu3gSATZ`) — file-log fallback, avoids Telegram recursion. Per-item fails still Telegram via **Send backup failed**.

**Also exports** this backup workflow itself (included on purpose).

Self-call per item for memory. Telegram: start + one completion summary with counts.
